content:
Hello all, announcing some joint work with Daniel Zach trying to formalize some things about (abstract) simplicial complexes and stellar subdivisions. We defined some notions of morphisms (especially for typecasting), subcomplexes like links, and derived some identities therewith. There are a couple seemingly new identities that arose while trying to correct a proof about subdividing combinatorial manifold boundaries.

Daniel just presented some of this work at ITP '26, which you can read in full or skim here.

Full project is available on Github: https://github.com/not-gary/pachner

This started as an educational project for myself, then Daniel. The goal wasn't mathlib integration at the start, rather we wanted to verify some details of a proof of Pachner's theorem. But, we're aware that this general topic has been of interest in the past, so we want to share our experience working with it. Especially since the adoption of AlgebraicTopology.(Pre)AbstractSimplicialComplex after we first submitted this manuscript. We make some remarks about what a theory of subdivisions might look like for these two objects, which people might find interesting.

Daniel is currently extending some of this work, and we're gradually improving the proofs and usability. So, any feedback is certainly welcome.

Great work! I feel (Pre)AbstractSimplicialComplexes in mathlib is lacking in applications, AFAICT it still only has the single additional file importing it, so I think it would be an improvement to add these results to mathlib or at least port them to the new definition to validate whether the IsRelLower thing works well or not.
